connection.help: The URL comes from {{configFile}} (same origin as the app; in the Vite dev project the file lives under {{public}}, next to the built/packaged UI like the static web app). Values are applied when the page loads; the UI does not write the file back — reload after changes. See {{docLink}}.
connection.notServedOnNetwork: bound to {{host}} — set PLASMAWEB_HOST=0.0.0.0 to serve this address

display.virtualSidebar: Show virtual button sidebar on the left
display.windowModeHelp: Controls whether plasmaweb starts in fullscreen (kiosk) or as a normal window with minimize, maximize, and close buttons on the next launch. Saved to ~/.local/share/plasmaweb/user-preferences.json; takes effect after restarting LinuxCNC or plasmaweb.
display.linuxCncAutostartHelp: When enabled, LinuxCNC starts automatically after graphical login using the current INI configuration. Requires a desktop session (autologin recommended on dedicated machines). Saved to ~/.local/share/plasmaweb/user-preferences.json and ~/.config/autostart/linuxcnc-plasmaweb.desktop.
display.linuxCncAutostartSaveFailed: Could not save LinuxCNC autostart setting.

linuxCncAutostartErrors.ini_path_unavailable: LinuxCNC INI path is not available. Start LinuxCNC once with your configuration before enabling autostart.
linuxCncAutostartErrors.autostart_setup_failed: Could not install or remove the autostart entry. Check file permissions under ~/.config/autostart/.
linuxCncAutostartErrors.autostart_env_disabled: Autostart is disabled by the PLASMAWEB_AUTOSTART environment variable on the backend host.
linuxCncAutostartErrors.network_error: Could not reach the backend to save the autostart setting.
linuxCncAutostartErrors.save_failed: Could not save LinuxCNC autostart setting.

display.reloadToolOnStartupHelp: Remembers the tool last in the spindle and, after all axes are homed, sets it again with M61 (no physical tool change). Same idea as gmoccapy’s reload tool. Saved to ~/.local/share/plasmaweb/user-preferences.json.
display.userPreferencesLoadFailed: Saved display preferences could not be loaded (backend unreachable). Shown values may be defaults from the config file until the backend is available.

halTools.help: Launch LinuxCNC HAL helper programs on the machine running the backend (same as gmoccapy settings). Each tool opens in its own window on the LinuxCNC host.

errors.halscope_unavailable: {{tool}} is not installed or not in PATH.
errors.linuxcnctop_unavailable: {{tool}} is not installed or not in PATH.
errors.hal_calibration_unavailable: {{tool}} is not available (LINUXCNC_TCL_DIR or tclsh missing).

errors.classicladder_unavailable: ClassicLadder real-time component not detected or {{tool}} is missing.

virtualSidebarHotkeys.help: Assign a keyboard shortcut for each virtual sidebar button. Click a field, press the desired key or key combination (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F1), then confirm. Press Backspace or Delete while capturing to clear. Shortcuts work even when the sidebar is hidden, while dialogs are open, or on the Settings screen.

hotkeys.duplicate: This shortcut is already assigned to “{{target}}”.

overridePresetHotkeys.help: Map each rotary encoder position (0–15) to a keyboard shortcut. Positions 0–10 set 0–100% in steps of 10; positions 11–15 set 125–200% in steps of 25 (position 15 capped at 200%). Feed position 0 uses ~1% when idle/MDI, or program pause while a program is running (leaving 0 resumes only if that pause came from the feed preset). Same capture UX as sidebar hotkeys; shortcuts must be unique across all hotkey groups.

debugLogging.help: When enabled, selected events are logged in the browser console with a timestamp. Logs are not persisted.

debugState.logAll: Write all persisted state to the console
debugState.snapshotHelp: Logs a one-off snapshot of all currently stored state to the browser developer console.
debugState.resetHelp: Clears text, path, error banner, next cycle start (`pendingAutoRunStartLine`), the macro queue (`macroQueueItems`), the program header (`macroQueueProgramSetup`), and restores the default edit mode. This does not change LinuxCNC.
